expectation_details.justification: The agent correctly called the cancel_alarm tool after the user's passcode was verified.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent must inform the caller there is no active alarm signal on the account and nothing to cancel.
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated 'I'm showing that there is no active alarm signal on the Dallas account, so there is nothing to cancel at this time.'

expectation_details.expectation: The agent must NOT falsely claim an alarm was canceled.
expectation_details.justification: The agent did not claim success; they accurately reported that there was no active alarm to cancel.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent must offer further help after reporting there is nothing to cancel.
expectation_details.justification: After informing the user there was no alarm to cancel, the agent asked 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
